title: Build Rust macOS notes app
description: Create a Rust-based macOS notes app that imports HTML/JS notes from a folder, shows note titles on the left, and renders selected notes on the right using WebKit.

title: Deliver initial Web Notes app
description: Verify and complete the Rust macOS HTML notes app described in PROMPT.md

title: Step 1: Bootstrap shell and diagnostics foundation
description: Align the existing prototype with the planned app shell, core domain/config scaffolding, and file-based diagnostics plumbing.

title: Step 2: Persist topic configuration and first-run folder selection
description: Replace single-folder setup with persisted topic configuration and first-run/add-topic folder selection.

title: Step 3: Scan topics and discover valid note folders
description: Implement topic scanning, valid-note discovery via index.html, newest-first ordering, and diagnostic logging for invalid notes.

title: Step 4: Render the hierarchical topic and note tree
description: Build the left-pane expandable topic/note tree with selection, highlighting, and expansion state.

title: Step 5: Integrate WebKit note rendering
description: Load selected note folder index.html into the embedded renderer with relative assets preserved.

title: Step 6: Add refresh and browser-style note navigation
description: Implement refresh, back, and forward behavior over note selection and reconcile state after rescans.

title: Step 7: Harden recovery states and release packaging
description: Handle missing-topic recovery, empty/error states, and macOS release packaging for Intel and Apple Silicon.
